foot.about: Kerfy Studio is a small French studio that makes BipAgents and Tablée.
foot.fine: No cookies and no trackers on this site.

home.title:
We build apps.
Not data factories.
home.lede: Kerfy Studio is a French software studio. Our apps: BipAgents, AI agents that work for you, and Tablée, family meals, sorted. Zero ads. Zero tracking. Plenty of coffee.

bip.pitch: Your own AI agents, the Bips: they book things, sort your email, keep your calendar and your Memo, and ask before they act. Built on Hermes Agent.
points: Your space in Europe, which we don’t read

tablee.pitch: The week’s menus planned for your family, recipes scaled to who’s eating, and a shopping list shared between your phones.
points: A family profile: allergies, likes, constraints
Weekly menus, portions fitted to the household
A synced shopping list to tick off in the shop
Your own recipes, and AI-assisted import

values.title: Private by design
values.text: Your data is there to serve you, not to profile you. No advertising, no reselling, no trackers on our sites.

values.title: Hosted in Europe
values.text: Our servers are in the European Union, and the GDPR applies to everything we do.

values.title: Open
values.text: BipAgents’ code is public under the MIT license: anyone can read it, check it and improve it.

values.title: For the whole family
values.text: Simple, friendly apps in English, French, German and Spanish.

home.companyText: Kerfy Studio develops and publishes its apps on the App Store and Google Play.
home.contactText: A question, a partnership, press? Write to us, we read everything.

support.title: We’re here to help.
support.lede: A question, a bug, an idea? Write to us: we answer as soon as we can, in English or French.

blocks.title: From the app
text: Settings › Contact support prepares an e-mail with a diagnostic of your phone: versions and your agents’ state, with no conversation, no name, no address and no key.
You read it before sending it.

blocks.title: A reply shocks you?
text: In the app, long-press the reply › Report this reply. The report reaches us, with the reply’s text.
Tell your agent too, so it doesn’t do it again.

blocks.title: Installing and troubleshooting
text: The install guide, the commands and answers to common problems are on GitHub.
If in doubt, write to us with the command’s output: we’ll look at it with you.

blocks.title: Your data
text: In the app: delete an agent, or uninstall the app to erase everything from the phone. On your server: bipagents uninstall --all.
For the little data we receive (e-mails, reports), write to privacy@bipagents.com: we delete it.

blocks.title: Security
text: Found a vulnerability? Write to security@bipagents.com: these reports are handled first.
Our security contact is also published in security.txt.

blocks.title: Privacy
text: What we receive, and above all what we don’t, is explained in the privacy policy.
